title: Create your best tracks yet with Lyria 3.5 in Gemini.
gist: Google launched Lyria 3.5, an upgraded music-generation model with more expressive vocals and richer arrangements, inside the Gemini app and API, and is simultaneously distributing it across Google Flow Music, Google AI Studio, and Google Vids.

themes.theme: Lyria 3.5 model and Gemini app capabilities

insights.claim: Lyria 3.5 is described as Google's best-sounding music generation model yet, now available in the Gemini app and the Gemini API.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Marks a concrete upgrade and wider distribution of Google's generative-music model, extending Gemini's product surface into audio content creation.
insights.quote: Lyria 3.5, our best-sounding music generation model, is now available in the Gemini app and the Gemini API.

insights.claim: Lyria 3.5 brings more expressive vocals and richer musical arrangements, allowing users to craft higher-fidelity tracks than before.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Vocal expressiveness and arrangement richness are the specific quality dimensions Google is claiming improved, useful for benchmarking against rival AI music tools.
insights.quote: Lyria 3.5 brings more expressive vocals and richer musical arrangements, allowing you to craft tracks with higher fidelity.

insights.claim: In the Gemini app, users can now select or describe a genre and choose between vocal or instrumental styles when generating a track.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Genre and vocal/instrumental controls indicate Google is prioritizing creative steerability, a key differentiator for AI music tools competing for creator adoption.
insights.quote: Easily select or describe your genre and choose between vocal or instrumental style
insights.locator: In the Gemini app, you can now

insights.claim: New templates and the option to choose short or longer track lengths were added to the Gemini app's music generation feature to help users start projects faster.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Templates and flexible track length lower the friction for casual users to produce usable output, widening the addressable audience beyond hobbyist experimentation.
insights.quote: Use our new templates to jumpstart your creativity for anything from background music to custom birthday tracks
insights.locator: In the Gemini app, you can now

insights.claim: Google is positioning the Gemini app's Lyria 3.5 feature for practical use cases such as custom backing tracks for videos, brand jingles, and personalized ringtones.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Framing around commercial and personal utility (jingles, ringtones, video backing tracks) suggests Google is targeting small-business and everyday-creator monetization use cases, not just novelty generation.
insights.quote: Whether you need a custom backing track for a video, a unique brand jingle, or just a personalized ringtone, it’s easier than ever to bring your idea to life.
insights.locator: Whether you need a custom backing track

insights.claim: Lyria 3.5 is being rolled out globally to all users on both web and mobile versions of the Gemini app.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: A simultaneous global, cross-platform rollout signals confidence in the model's readiness and scale of ambition for the feature.
insights.quote: Lyria 3.5 is available to all users globally on the web and in the mobile app.
insights.locator: Lyria 3.5 is available to all users globally

insights.claim: Beyond the Gemini app, Lyria 3.5 is also being made available in Google Flow Music for artists and AI creatives, and through Google AI Studio and Google Vids for developers and technologists.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Embedding the same underlying model across consumer, professional-creative, and developer surfaces shows Google treating Lyria as shared infrastructure across its AI product portfolio rather than a single-app novelty.
insights.quote: It’s also available for artists and AI creatives in Google Flow Music, and for developers and technologists through Google AI Studio, and Google Vids.
